predecessor.diagnosis: Temporal image-order consensus was stable but selected a reverse-side geometric projection: second and third were swapped, causing two taskwise regressions and recall 1.0 to 0.333.
predecessor.information_change: Add frame-aligned measured depth and intrinsics so a pose is admissible only when every candidate agrees with observed depth. Reuse the SC34 public ordinal-inventory representation to recover a hidden leading-slot offset without target membership. Keep lattice, pose, frustum, span, and temporal-consensus thresholds unchanged.

source.dataset: SceneFun3D plus ARKitScenes low-resolution poses, depth, and wide-camera intrinsics

selection.ordering: ascending visit_id then video_id from the official one-video CSV
selection.stop_rule: Stop immediately after the first depth-visible temporally stable self-carrier active-view opportunity.

frozen_algorithm.ordinal_inventory_rule: For each directional cue independently, public task ordinals must be consecutive and their cardinality must equal the sealed lattice cardinality.
frozen_algorithm.absolute_rank_mapping: Map the requested ordinal to its zero-based position in the admitted public ordinal inventory, then apply the visible left-to-right or right-to-left camera order.
frozen_algorithm.view_selection: Require every candidate projection to agree with observed depth, then require the unchanged temporal left-to-right order consensus and maximize horizontal span.
frozen_algorithm.left_right_authority: Depth-visible temporally agreed camera-frame projected x order; smaller x is left. Public task ordinal inventory supplies only the hidden-prefix offset.
frozen_algorithm.baseline: All candidates in the admitted local same-action lattice remain set-valued.

forbidden_after_source_access: read description annot_id values during provider construction
change depth, alignment, lattice, temporal, span, frustum, or ranking thresholds
choose candidates, frames, pose windows, or orders using evaluator outcomes
claim_boundary: Target-exposed consumed-mechanism source admission for a privileged functional lattice plus frame-aligned depth-visible real active views. A positive result may establish mechanics only, never fresh transfer, RGB proposal quality, online view reachability, tracking, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, or safety.
